example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (f : Tarski.NF) (a : Nat)
    (env : Nat → V) (x y : V) :
    DeepPositiveClosure.MatrixRelation mem (NamedForm254.matrix f a a) env x y ↔
      Tarski.Sat mem (Tarski.update (Tarski.update env a x) a y) f :=
  NamedForm254.sat_matrix mem f a a env x y
example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (a : Nat) (env : Nat → V) :
    SetTheory.Sat mem env (NamedForm254.translate id (.all a (.all a (.eq a a)))) :=
  (NamedForm254.sat_translate mem _ id env).mpr (fun _ _ => rfl)
example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (v : V)
    (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x) (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ¬ Code254Models.ModelsDecoded (DuplicateProfiles.duplicateMem mem) :=
  DuplicateProfiles.duplicate_not_decoded mem v hirr h
